post.description:
Retrieve estimates. Input: dataset path (acs/acs5, acs/acs1, acs/acs5/subject, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, dec/dhc, pep/population, cbp ...), vintage, 1-200 variable names or group(TABLE) tokens, and a geography as Data API for/in predicates (for: 'county:*', in: ['state:06']). Returns one row per geography with values as published, sentinels turned into null plus annotation, FIPS parts, variable metadata with units, and the equivalent api.census.gov URL. Unknown variables are rejected with invalid_input naming them.

predicates.description: Exact-match filters on any returned column, e.g. {"NAICS2017": "00", "EMPSZES": "001"} for CBP or {"DATE_CODE": "12"} for PEP.

records.description: The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing survey that provides data every year -- giving communities the current information they need to plan investments and services. The ACS covers a broad range of topics about social, economic, demographic, and housing characteristics of the U.S. population. Summary files include the following geographies: nation, all states (including DC and Puerto Rico), all metropolitan areas, all congressional districts, all counties, all places, and all tracts and block groups. post.description:
Full collection of county poverty counts/rates and median household income for a year, optionally for one state.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. It pins the vintage, file, Last-Modified and size; when the source has moved on the call fails with invalid_input at /continuation (issue code publication_changed) instead of mixing versions.

page_size.description:
Records per page; default 500.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5000.

state.description: State as 2-digit FIPS (30) or postal code (MT, mt). Pattern: ^([0-9]{2}|[A-Za-z]{2})$.

year.description:
SAIPE estimate year (directory saipe/datasets/<year>/<year>-state-and-county/). Default: the newest year directory. Positions verified against the 2019 and 2024 layout READMEs; lines that do not fit the layout are rejected.

Provider reference: minimum 2010; maximum 2035.

200.description:
List SAIPE state-and-county poverty and median household income estimates for one year: est<yy>all.txt (US, 51 states, every county; 3,196 lines for 2024) or, with state, est<yy>-<st>.txt (state row first, then its counties). Fixed-width positions per the layout README: state 1-2, county 4-6, poverty all ages 8-48, age 0-17 50-90, related children 5-17 92-132, median household income 134-153, under 5 155-192 (US and states only), name 194-238, postal 240-241, file tag 243-264. Blanks and '.' become null; FIPS stay zero-padded strings. The file is fetched per call and paged from memory; the cursor pins year, file, Last-Modified and size. source_record_id = saipe<year>:<state_fips><county_fips>.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | string | SHA-256 of the decoded file bytes. |
| `count` | number |  |

| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `hash_source` | string |  |
| `last_modified` | string | Last-Modified header, ISO 8601. |
| `next_cursor` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `offset` | number |  |

| `records` | object[] |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `size_bytes` | number | Decoded byte length of the file (the server sends it gzip-encoded without Content-Length). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `state` | string | Uppercase postal code of the per-state file; null for the national file. |
| `total_records` | number |  |
| `year` | number |  |

post.description:
List variables of one dataset vintage. Input: dataset path and vintage, plus a group (table id such as B01003 or DP05) and/or a free-text query matched against group descriptions and variable labels. Returns variable name, verbatim label, concept, predicate type, group and the unit phrase the label carries.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

dataset.description: Data API dataset path, e.g. acs/acs5, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, cbp. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_/]+$.

group.description: Table id, e.g. B01003, S0101, DP05, P1. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 20.

query.description: Tokens matched against group name/description (when no group is given; the first 5 matching groups are listed) or variable name/label/concept (within a group). Datasets with at most 5 tables (cbp, pep/population) whose descriptions do not match are searched by variable label instead.
